        return 0
    current = 0
    count = 0
    while current * 10 + 1 <= n:
        current = current * 10 + 1
        count += 1
    resA = count * (n // current) + evaluate(n % current)
    resB = count + 1
    n = 10 * current + 1 - n
    resB += count * (n // current) + evaluate(n % current)
    return min(resA, resB)
